title: Duals with two pads
description: Duals in a split fight on two faked gamepads: found by chance with the no-target half (Escudo de bits) chosen first; a known dual on every foe going off with each player confirming on a different foe; Sutura de luz, on one ally, waiting until both pick the same; and a dual called off when the partner falls mid-aim. Each check is an `until` that fails the run if it breaks.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.pick = (p, re) => { const ui = window.gerard.battleUI; ui.control('down', p); ui.control('confirm', p); for (let i = 0; i < 16 && !re.test(document.querySelector(`.battle-dock[data-dock="${p}"] .is-cursor-${p}`)?.textContent ?? ''); i++) ui.control('down', p); ui.control('confirm', p); }; window.dock = p => document.querySelector(`.battle-dock[data-dock="${p}"]`); window.used = id => (window.gerard.battleUI.live?.usedDuals ?? []).includes(id);

steps.caption: Two players: Aitor picks Escudo de bits, a skill with no target. While Gerard can still choose it asks for a confirm (Todo el equipo) instead of going off at once
Gerard confirms Foc Binari: the two halves meet and Sobrecalentamiento is found (DÚO DESBLOQUEADO), whichever was chosen first

(() => { const ui = window.gerard.battleUI; const aim = p => document.querySelector(`.${p === 1 ? 'is-targeted' : 'is-targeted-2'}[data-target]`)?.dataset.target; if (aim(1) === aim(2)) ui.control('down', 2); ui.control('confirm', 1); ui.control('confirm', 2); })()

steps.caption: Sutura de luz goes to one ally: each confirmed on a different card, so it waits (Elegid el mismo objetivo)
Aitor moves to Gerard's pick and confirms: Sutura de luz goes off on that ally
